rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: ThornGuard is a security proxy layer that sits between MCP clients and upstream MCP servers, providing ingress request blocking, egress data redaction, policy enforcement, and audit logging. It protects against prompt injection, credential exposure, and unauthorized commands across Claude Desktop, VS Code, Cursor, Zed, and other MCP clients. Requires a Qwady license key and self-hosted configuration.
